q1.explanationZh: anybody“任何人”，由 any + body 构成，与 anyone 意思相同，多用于否定句、疑问句和条件句。

q2.explanationZh: anyhow 由 any + how 构成，副词“不管怎样说；无论如何”。

q3.explanationZh: anymore 副词“（不）再”，常用于否定句句末，如 not...anymore。

q4.explanationZh: anyone“任何人”，由 any + one 构成，与 anybody 意思相同。

q5.explanationZh: anything“任何事情”，多用于否定句和疑问句，anything but“一点也不”。

q6.explanationZh: anyway 由 any + way 构成，副词“无论如何；不管怎么说”。

q7.explanationZh: anywhere 由 any + where 构成，副词“在（或往）任何地方”。

q8.explanationZh: apart 副词“相间隔；分开”，apart from“除……之外”。

q9.explanationZh: apartment“一套公寓房间”，由 apart + -ment 构成。

q10.explanationZh: ape 名词“类人猿；模仿者”，作及物动词“模仿”。

q11.explanationZh: apologise 是英式拼写，apologize 是美式拼写，都是不及物动词“道歉”，apologise to sb. for sth.。

q12.explanationZh: apologise 的名词是 apology“道歉”，make an apology to sb.“向某人道歉”。

q13.explanationZh: app 是 application 的缩写，“应用软件；应用程序”。

q14.explanationZh: apparent 形容词“显然的”，常用 It is/becomes apparent that...。

q15.explanationZh: apparent 加 -ly 构成副词 apparently“显然”。

q16.explanationZh: appeal 动词、名词同形，“呼吁；有吸引力”，appeal to sb.“对某人有吸引力”。

q17.explanationZh: appear 不及物动词“出现；看来好像”，反义词 disappear“消失”。

q18.explanationZh: appear 加 -ance 构成名词 appearance“出现；外表”。

q19.explanationZh: appetite 名词“食欲；欲望”，常和 for 连用，如 an appetite for...。

q20.explanationZh: applaud 是动词“鼓掌；称赞”，名词是 applause。

q21.explanationZh: applaud 的名词 applause“鼓掌；喝彩”，不可数。

q22.explanationZh: apple“苹果”，谚语 An apple a day keeps the doctor away.

q24.explanationZh: apply 的派生词 applicant“申请人”，-ant 表示人。

q25.explanationZh: apply 的名词 application“应用；申请”，y 变 i 再加 -cation。

q26.explanationZh: apply 作及物动词“应用”，作不及物动词“申请；适用”，apply for“申请”。

q27.explanationZh: appoint 及物动词“任命；约定”，名词 appointment。

q28.explanationZh: appoint 加 -ment 构成名词 appointment“约会；预约”。

q29.explanationZh: appreciate 及物动词“感激；欣赏”，后面直接接宾语。

q30.explanationZh: appreciate 去 e 加 -ion 构成名词 appreciation“感激；欣赏”。

q31.explanationZh: approach 动词“接近；临近”，名词“方法；途径”。

q32.explanationZh: appropriate“合适的”，be appropriate for“适合……”，反义词 inappropriate。

q33.explanationZh: approve“批准；赞成”，表示“赞成”常用 approve of。

q34.explanationZh: approximate 加 -ly 构成副词 approximately“大约”。

q35.explanationZh: “向某人道歉”= apologise to sb.，apologise 是不及物动词，要加 to。

q36.explanationZh: 动词短语 apologise to sb. for sth.：to 引出道歉的对象，for 引出原因。

accept: make/give/offer an apology to sb. for sth.
make an apology to sb. for sth.
give an apology to sb. for sth.
offer an apology to sb. for sth.

q37.explanationZh: 名词短语 make/give/offer an apology to sb. for sth.，apology 是可数名词，前面用 an。

q38.explanationZh: “呼吁某人”= appeal to sb.，appeal 是不及物动词，要加 to。

q39.explanationZh: appeal to sb. for sth.“为某事向某人呼吁”，for 引出呼吁的内容。

accept: appeal to sb. to do sth.

q40.explanationZh: appeal to sb. to do sth.“呼吁某人做某事”，后接不定式。

q41.explanationZh: 表示“赞成”时 approve 常与 of 连用：approve of sth./doing sth.。

q42.explanationZh: appeal to“呼吁；对……有吸引力”，如 appeal to young people。

q43.explanationZh: apply A to B“把 A 应用于 B”，to 是介词。

q44.explanationZh: apply for“申请”，如 apply for a job“申请工作”。

q45.explanationZh: add more appeal to“给……增添更多魅力”，more 后接不可数名词 appeal“吸引力”。

q46.explanationZh: “相距 500 米”= stand 500 metres apart，apart 是副词“相间隔”。

q48.explanationZh: 否定句中用 anything“任何事情”，作 say 的宾语。

q49.explanationZh: applaud“向……鼓掌”，叙述过去的事用过去式 applauded。

q50.explanationZh: apologise to sb. for sth.“因某事向某人道歉”，情态动词 should 后用原形。

q51.explanationZh: appeal to sb.“对某人有吸引力”，助动词 Does 后用动词原形 appeal。

q52.explanationZh: apply A to B“把 A 应用于 B”，情态动词 can 后用原形 apply。

q53.explanationZh: 句子缺主语，用名词 appreciation“欣赏”，appreciation of works of art“对艺术作品的欣赏”；句首字母大写。

q54.explanationZh: so many 后接可数名词复数，applicants“申请者”。

q55.explanationZh: It appears that...“看来……”，主语 It 是第三人称单数，一般现在时用 appears。

q56.explanationZh: the application of A to B“把 A 应用于 B”，冠词 The 后用名词 application。

q57.explanationZh: 有餐厅和客厅的是一套公寓房间，this 后用单数 apartment。

q59.explanationZh: judge a person by his appearance“以貌取人”，his 后用名词 appearance“外表”。

q60.sampleAnswer: The instant this application was launched to the market, a heated discussion was aroused.
references: The instant this application was launched to the market, a heated discussion was aroused.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q60.explanationZh: “应用程序”= application；“一……就……”可用 the instant 引导时间状语从句；“引发热议”= arouse a heated discussion。

q61.sampleAnswer: Your past work experiences might not be in line with the post you apply for.
references: Your past work experiences might not be in line with the post you apply for.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: “申请”= apply for，the post you apply for 是定语从句；“与……吻合”= be in line with。

q62.sampleAnswer: Wood-carving techniques have an enduring appeal, because craftsmen have perfected and passed down their skills from generation to generation.
references: Wood-carving techniques have an enduring appeal, because craftsmen have perfected and passed down their skills from generation to generation.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: “经久不衰”= have an enduring appeal，appeal 作名词“吸引力”；“代代相传”= pass down from generation to generation。

q63.sampleAnswer: The principle of diligence and frugality applies to all undertakings.
references: The principle of diligence and frugality applies to all undertakings.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: “适用于”= apply to；主语 The principle 是单数，用 applies。

q64.sampleAnswer: His parents won’t approve of his dropping out of high school.
references: His parents won’t approve of his dropping out of high school.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: “赞成”= approve of，of 后接动名词，his dropping out 中 his 是动名词的逻辑主语；“辍学”= drop out of school。

q65.sampleAnswer: Although he was more than 50 years old, he was still firmly convinced that he could reach the top of the tower without any difficulty to appreciate the beautiful rivers and mountains of his motherland.
references: Although he was more than 50 years old, he was still firmly convinced that he could reach the top of the tower without any difficulty to appreciate the beautiful rivers and mountains of his motherland.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “欣赏”= appreciate；“坚信”= be firmly convinced that；“轻而易举”= without any difficulty。

q66.sampleAnswer: Apart from the fact that we went to the same school, we had absolutely nothing in common.
references: Apart from the fact that we went to the same school, we had absolutely nothing in common.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: “除了……之外”= apart from，the fact 后接 that 同位语从句；“没有共同之处”= have nothing in common。

q67.sampleAnswer: As graduation is approaching, I feel happy and proud of myself and also realize that only by continuous learning and hard work can I have a promising future.
references: As graduation is approaching, I feel happy and proud of myself and also realize that only by continuous learning and hard work can I have a promising future.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: “毕业在即”= graduation is approaching，approach“临近”；“only + 状语”放句首时句子部分倒装：can I have。

q68.sampleAnswer: Never had it occurred to him that he could stand out in the fierce competition and win so much applause and encouragement after over ten years of hard work.
references: Never had it occurred to him that he could stand out in the fierce competition and win so much applause and encouragement after over ten years of hard work.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q68.explanationZh: “掌声”= applause，不可数，用 so much 修饰；否定词 Never 放句首要部分倒装：had it occurred to him。

q69.sampleAnswer: Only by reciting words is it impossible for anyone to get a good grade in the exam, not to mention the ability to communicate with foreigners.
references: Only by reciting words is it impossible for anyone to get a good grade in the exam, not to mention the ability to communicate with foreigners.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q69.explanationZh: “任何人”= anyone；“it is impossible for sb. to do sth.”；“更不用说”= not to mention。
